query: INSERT INTO device_identity (device_id, backend, public_key_der, apple_sign_count, tpm_ek_public, tpm_ek_certificate_chain_der, apple_key_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO UPDATE SET backend = EXCLUDED.backend, public_key_der = EXCLUDED.public_key_der, apple_sign_count = EXCLUDED.apple_sign_count, tpm_ek_public = EXCLUDED.tpm_ek_public, tpm_ek_certificate_chain_der = EXCLUDED.tpm_ek_certificate_chain_der, apple_key_id = EXCLUDED.apple_key_id
